brief.headline: You are 1.38% of their business — use that to push for faster payment terms and free up ₹1.24 Cr cash for us

priceAsk.summary: Hold the current price; it's already market-fair
priceAsk.basis: Our price sits in the typical market band of ₹66–73/kg for Anhydrous Dextrose IP, and the market verdict is 'MARKET-FAIR (slightly favourable)'. India export unit value is 42.95 ₹/kg, but that's raw export data. With their thin 1.1% profit, a price cut risks our supply.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to payment on delivery (0 days), or at least cut 15 days
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Moving to 0 days frees up ₹1.24 Cr cash for us; cutting just 15 days frees up ₹61.76 L — real money we can use elsewhere

brief.financialLeverage: They make ₹1087.88 Cr in sales but keep only 1.1% as profit — about ₹1 of every ₹100 they sell. They owe 2.37x their own cash (₹226.98 Cr total owed), so cash is valuable to them. Your ₹15.03 Cr spend is 1.38% of everything they sell — a real chunk they don't want to lose. Push hard on payment terms (they'll value the faster cash), but tread carefully on price because there's almost no profit cushion.

evidence.point: We are a big customer to them
They carry heavy debt relative to their own cash
Our current price is already in the market-fair band
Cash we can free up by moving to payment on delivery

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed maker (₹2359.06 Cr revenue, health B 62/100); established dextrose supplier — a credible drop-in alternate to Sayaji

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (₹821.13 Cr revenue, health C 53/100); growing dextrose capacity

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore wet-miller (₹365.39 Cr revenue, health D 27/100); makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade) — exact form match; confirm IP monograph CoA before switching

risks: Their profit is only 1.1% — pushing price too hard could hurt supply or force them to cut corners
They owe 2.37x their own cash and scored D (18/100) on health — watch for any supply hiccups or delivery delays
We're already at the best price we pay anyone (₹66.48/KG, 0.0% gap), so the win is in payment terms, not price
If we squeeze too hard and they stumble, we have three alternates lined up, but switching takes time and requalification
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: You're a key partner — we spend ₹15.03 Cr a year with you, over 1% of your total business — so let's talk about how we can both win: we'd like to move to faster payment in exchange for keeping this volume with you.
